name: Three Nights on the Road (Tam Dạ Đạo Thượng)

bonuses.rule: Against a foe marked by The Leader First, your bow arts bypass 25 % more of its ward, and The Leader First deals 1.5 % more damage per second since your last shot or fight start (15 % per 10 s), resetting when The Leader First lands.

story: The bow and the coat of the wolf winter. Hứa Vãn Cung holds both.
